test_boostbuild_typecheck: test the BoostBuild typechecking facilities by running a jam file with path-typed arguments
run_boostbuild_tester: run the BoostBuild Tester to write a jam file and execute the build system with arguments
write_jam_file: write a jam file using BoostBuild Tester that defines typechecked rules and actions
verify_typecheck_error: verify that BoostBuild reports an argument error when a non-path value is passed to a path-typed rule
cleanup_boostbuild_tester: cleanup the BoostBuild Tester after running typecheck test scenarios
